preconditions.description: The length of the string P is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'c', 'h', 'e', 'f'} for c in P)
preconditions.description: The string P consists only of the characters 'c', 'h', 'e', and 'f'.
The number of queries Q is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L <= R <= len(P) for L, R in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, L and R satisfy 1 ≤ L ≤ R ≤ |P|.

preconditions.expression: all(a != b for a, b, L, R in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, the characters a and b are different.

preconditions.expression: all(a in {'c', 'h', 'e', 'f'} for a, b, L, R in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, the character a is one of 'c', 'h', 'e', or 'f'.

preconditions.expression: all(b in {'c', 'h', 'e', 'f'} for a, b, L, R in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, the character b is one of 'c', 'h', 'e', or 'f'.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(answer, int) for answer in answers)
all(0 <= answer <= (R - L) * (R - L - 1) // 2 for answer, (a, b, L, R) in zip(answers, queries))
postconditions.description: Each answer is a non-negative integer not exceeding the maximum possible number of substrings.

postconditions.expression: all(answer == sum(1 for S_i in range(L-1, R) for E_i in range(S_i+1, R) if P[S_i] == a and P[E_i] == b and P[S_i] != P[E_i]) for answer, (a, b, L, R) in zip(answers, queries))
postconditions.description: Each answer correctly counts the number of good strings starting with a and ending with b within the specified range.
